title: Cloud & Branch Connector regions: three region lists that must not be conflated
aliases: is cloud connector available in region

prose.text: "Is it available in this region?" has three different answers depending on what is meant. Each list below answers only its own question.

steps.label: Customer-deployed Cloud Connector VMs.
steps.text: Where the VM itself can be deployed: [[cloud-connector.regions.deployment]].

steps.label: Zscaler-managed Zero Trust Gateways.
steps.text: The help article's AWS and GCP tables: [[cloud-connector.regions.zero-trust-gateways]].

prose.text: No source states that any two of these lists are equal, or that the gateway tables match Public Service Edge locations {{gap:region-set-parity}}.
How Cloud Connectors in different regions relate to each other, and to the Service Edges they reach: [[cloud-connector.regions.topology]].

checks.do: Which of the three region questions is being asked: VM deployment, Zero Trust Gateway, or workload discovery.
For workload discovery, the tenant's live answer from the supported-regions endpoint rather than a gateway table.

wds-endpoint.statement: The API's `/publicCloudInfo/supportedRegions` operation is described as retrieving the AWS regions supported for workload discovery settings (WDS); its items are regions supported by Zscaler's Tag Discovery Service.

expect.description: Retrieves a list of AWS regions supported for  workload discovery settings (WDS).
Regions supported by Zscaler’s Tag Discovery Service.
expect.title: SupportedRegion

wds-cloud-types.statement: Each returned region has an `id`, a `name` and a `cloudType` whose values are AWS, AZURE and GCP, although the same field's description calls AWS the default and mandatory value.

expect.description: The cloud type. The default and mandatory value is AWS.

region-set-parity.title: Whether the workload-discovery, Zero Trust Gateway and Cloud Connector region sets coincide
region-set-parity.detail: The workload-discovery set is a live tenant answer; the Zero Trust Gateway tables are a help article; no region list for Cloud Connector VMs is captured. Nothing states that any two are equal, or that the gateway tables correspond one-to-one to Public Service Edge locations. Part of ledger entry cloud-connector-22 (whose deployment questions sit in cloud-connector.regions.deployment:standard-cc-regions).
region-set-parity.blocks: using one region list to answer a question about another
